name: burrow-go-inspect
description: The Go value inspector for Burrow (architecture task 05): a path-addressed DAP value model + type-aware summaries (WO-3) rendered as a Miller-column + value-pane webview (WO-5) — the chosen inspector after WO-6 retired the WO-4 native tree. Retiring the stock VS Code Variables view is core patch 0006.

scripts.test: node test/summary.test.js && node test/literal.test.js && node test/watchmap.test.js && node test/inlinemap.test.js && node test/goroutines.test.js && node test/framerows.test.js && node test/capabilities.test.js

burrow.inspector.inlineValues.description: Ghost the active frame's values inline in the editor, after `:=`, `var` and function parameters. Uses the same summary renderer as the Burrow inspector.
